items.summary: Healthcare company Baxter International (NYSE:BAX) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5.3% year on year to $2.96 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.56 per share was 52.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
